eyebrow: Azure Event Hubs — a real message broker
code:
# A managed service built specifically to ingest
# MASSIVE volumes of events -- millions/second --
# from many producers at once.
#
# Genuinely different from Autoloader (files ALREADY sitting
# in storage). Event Hubs receives events being produced NOW.
caption: Real production-scale ingestion infrastructure.
